body:

Drop it off in person at your county board of elections by 7:30 PM tomorrow. [FIND MY POLLING PLACE ->](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhddthd-hkhielhuy-j/) **Think about what happens if we lose the House. Higher taxes. Open borders. Weak on crime. Don't hand it to her!This election is TOO IMPORTANT to sit out. **Make your plan NOW, bring three friends, and let 's WIN!** Congressman Tim Moore
